sources.support: Nisos states that a major technology-platform client and its legal counsel investigated two former employees who had supplied false employment documentation and behaved suspiciously. Nisos reports falsified identity documents, copied resume language, limited social presence, and reuse of application credentials and network-origin evidence associated with North Korean threat actors. Nisos assessed the two individuals as likely associated with one another and part of a DPRK remote-employment effort, and states that the client terminated them and supplied actionable intelligence to law enforcement. Evidence boundary: An anonymized provider-authored client success account. It does not name the employer or workers, publish a charge or adjudication, or establish that every cited signal independently proves DPRK affiliation
